Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

error.description: Lookup failure detail — a configured but unreachable registry, distinct from an unconfigured one.

recognised.description: Whether the community recognises this DID. Meaningless unless registryConfigured is true.

registryConfigured.description: Whether a trust registry backs the answer. False makes `recognised` indeterminate, not negative.
